results.title: Clashing Through the Snow
results.overview: Rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell and Hannah Hendricks are stranded by a holiday snowstorm and forced to share a rental car to New York, where a career-saving deal awaits them both. As roadside mishaps and small-town detours pile up, the holiday spirit begins to melt their fierce rivalry into something unexpected.

results.title: Steps
results.overview: After being blamed for disrupting the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, a misunderstood stepsister accidentally turns her sister into a frog and must team up with Cinderella and an unlikely ally to save the kingdom and rewrite their fairytale ending.

results.title: Guarding Stars
results.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

results.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
results.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
results.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

results.title: Madden
results.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football's most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

results.title: Heartland
results.overview: Former country music legend Misty Jones returns to Nashville to unravel the truth behind her rising-star niece's disappearance.

results.title: The Christmas Switch
results.overview: Craving a change of pace, work-hard-play-hard city girl Freddie swaps lives with her homebody sister Mattie at Christmas time, only to unwrap a whole new kind of mess.

results.title: Allen
results.overview: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

results.title: Never Surrender
results.overview: When a deadly gang descends on his remote home, a guilt-ridden veteran and the estranged grandchildren he barely knows must unite to survive.

results.title: Ebenezer
results.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

results.title: How to Rob a Bank
results.overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

results.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.original_title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.overview: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

results.title: I Play Rocky
results.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

results.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
results.overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

results.title: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
results.overview: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

results.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
results.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

results.title: A Story of Derry
results.overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

results.title: Collision Course
results.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

results.title: Wild Horse Nine
results.overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

results.title: The Awakening
results.overview: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.
